page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. With a single thread per core configuration, the instance provides 64 vCPUs alongside 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a dense memory footprint makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring substantial RAM without the overhead of hyperthreading.

The ecs.r7.16xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale in-memory databases, caching layers, data analytics pipelines, and enterprise resource planning applications that require significant memory capacity and dedicated CPU resources.
